maxR end return h.shoulder + v end local function stepSpring(h, target, dt) local w = CFG.smooth local e = exp(-w * dt) local x = h.pos - target local tmp = h.vel + x * w h.pos = target + (x + tmp * dt) * e h.vel = (h.vel - tmp * w * dt) * e h.roll = h.roll + (h.rollTarget - h.roll) * (1 - exp(-w * dt)) end local function buildHandCF(h) local v = h.pos - h.shoulder local dir = v.Magnitude > 0.05 and v.Unit or DOWN h.dir = dir local up = abs(dir.Y) > 0.98 and V3(0, 0, -1) or Vector3.yAxis h.cf = CFrame.lookAt(h.pos, h.pos + dir, up) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, h.roll) end local function savePose(n) slots[n] = { L = {pos = hands.L.pos, roll = hands.L.roll}, R = {pos = hands.R.pos, roll = hands.R.roll}, } notify("Pose " .. n .. " guardada") end local function loadPose(n) local s = slots[n] if not s then notify("Pose " .. n .. " vacía") return end for k, h in pairs(hands) do h.target = s[k].pos h.rollTarget = s[k].roll h.pinned = true end notify("Pose " .. n .. " cargada") end local function startRecording() rec.frames = {} rec.t = 0 S.recording = true S.playing = false notify("● Grabando (R para terminar)") end local function stopRecording() S.recording = false notify("Grabación lista: " .. #rec.frames .. " cuadros") end local function startPlayback() if #rec.frames < 2 then notify("No hay nada grabado") return end S.playing = true S.recording = false play.t = 0 play.i = 1 notify("▶ Reproduciendo (P para parar)") end local function sampleRecording(tm) local f = rec.frames local n = #f local i = play.i if i > n - 1 then i = 1 end while i < n - 1 and f[i + 1].t < tm do i = i + 1 end play.i = i local a, b = f[i], f[i + 1] local span = math.max(b.t - a.t, 1e-4) return a, b, clamp((tm - a.t) / span, 0, 1) end local function resetAll() for _, h in pairs(hands) do h.target = h.rest h.rollTarget = 0 h.depth = CFG.depth h.pinned = false end S.recording = false S.playing = false notify("Reiniciado") end local function toggleEnabled() S.enabled = not S.enabled if not S.enabled then state.valid = false resetJoints() end notify(S.enabled and "VR activado" or "VR desactivado") end bind(UIS.InputBegan, function(input) if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end local k = input.KeyCode local ctrl = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl) if k == Enum.KeyCode.V then toggleEnabled() elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.T then S.autoReturn = not S.autoReturn notify(S.autoReturn and "Retorno automático" or "Mantener posición") elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.L then S.headLook = not S.headLook notify(S.headLook and "Cabeza sigue el cursor" or "Cabeza sigue la cámara") elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.X then S.longReach = not S.longReach notify(S.longReach and "Alcance largo" or "Alcance normal") elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.N then S.noclip = not S.noclip notify(S.noclip and "No-clip jugadores ON" or "No-clip jugadores OFF") elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.H then S.help = not S.help helpPanel.Visible = S.help and S.hud elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.U then S.hud = not S.hud panel.Visible = S.hud helpPanel.Visible = S.hud and S.help elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Y then resetAll() elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.R and not ctrl then if S.recording then stopRecording() else startRecording() end elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.P then if S.playing then S.playing = false notify("Reproducción detenida") else startPlayback() end elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.LeftBracket then CFG.smooth = clamp(CFG.smooth - 2, 6, 60) elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket then CFG.smooth = clamp(CFG.smooth + 2, 6, 60) elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.One or k == Enum.KeyCode.Two or k == Enum.KeyCode.Three then local n = k == Enum.KeyCode.One and 1 or (k == Enum.KeyCode.Two and 2 or 3) if ctrl then savePose(n) else loadPose(n) end end end) CAS:BindActionAtPriority("NexusVRPC_Wheel", function(_, inputState, input) if not S.enabled or not currentMode then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end if inputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Change then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end local dz = input.Position.Z if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) and currentMode == "both" then CFG.gripWidth = clamp(CFG.gripWidth + dz * 0.1, 0.2, 4) else local d = dz * 0.2 local function bump(h) h.depth = clamp(h.depth + d, CFG.depthMin, CFG.depthMax) end if currentMode == "L" then bump(hands.L) elseif currentMode == "R" then bump(hands.R) else bump(hands.L) bump(hands.R) end end return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value, Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel) local lastSend = 0 local statusAcc = 0 bind(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt) dt = math.min(dt, 0.1) cam = workspace.CurrentCamera statusAcc = statusAcc + dt if statusAcc >= 0.1 then statusAcc = 0 refreshStatus() end local char = plr.Character local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if not root or not S.enabled then state.valid = false markerL.Visible = false markerR.Visible = false return end local now = os.clock() local rootCF = root.CFrame local chest = rootCF.Position + rootCF.UpVector * 0.6 local loc = UIS:GetMouseLocation() local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(loc.X, loc.Y) local function pointAt(depth) local s = (chest - ray.Origin):Dot(ray.Direction) + depth return rootCF:PointToObjectSpace(ray.Origin + ray.Direction * s) end local mode = getMode() currentMode = mode local activeL = mode == "L" or mode == "both" or mode == "mirror" local activeR = mode == "R" or mode == "both" or mode == "mirror" if mode == "L" then hands.L.target = clampReach(hands.L, pointAt(hands.L.depth)) elseif mode == "R" then hands.R.target = clampReach(hands.R, pointAt(hands.R.depth)) elseif mode == "both" then local p = pointAt((hands.L.depth + hands.R.depth) / 2) local rv = rootCF:VectorToObjectSpace(cam.CFrame.RightVector) hands.L.target = clampReach(hands.L, p - rv * (CFG.gripWidth / 2)) hands.R.target = clampReach(hands.R, p + rv * (CFG.gripWidth / 2)) elseif mode == "mirror" then local p = pointAt(hands.R.depth) local x = math.max(abs(p.X), 0.3) hands.R.target = clampReach(hands.R, V3(x, p.Y, p.Z)) hands.L.target = clampReach(hands.L, V3(-x, p.Y, p.Z)) end local rd = (key(Enum.KeyCode.Z) and -1 or 0) + (key(Enum.KeyCode.C) and 1 or 0) for k, h in pairs(hands) do local active = (k == "L" and activeL) or (k == "R" and activeR) if active then h.pinned = false if rd ~= 0 then h.rollTarget = h.rollTarget + rd * CFG.rollSpeed * dt end elseif S.autoReturn and not h.pinned and not S.playing then h.target = h.rest h.rollTarget = 0 end end if S.recording then rec.t = rec.t + dt rec.frames[#rec.frames + 1] = { t = rec.t, L = {pos = hands.L.target, roll = hands.L.rollTarget}, R = {pos = hands.R.target, roll = hands.R.rollTarget}, } if rec.t >= CFG.maxRecord then stopRecording() end end if S.playing then play.t = play.t + dt local total = rec.frames[#rec.frames].t if play.t > total then play.t = play.t - total play.i = 1 end local a, b, al = sampleRecording(play.t) for k, h in pairs(hands) do local active = (k == "L" and activeL) or (k == "R" and activeR) if not active then h.target = a[k].pos:Lerp(b[k].pos, al) h.rollTarget = a[k].roll + (b[k].roll - a[k].roll) * al h.pinned = true end end end local phase = 0 for _, h in pairs(hands) do local sway = V3(0, sin(now * 1.6 + phase) * 0.012, cos(now * 1.3 + phase) * 0.008) stepSpring(h, h.target + sway, dt) buildHandCF(h) phase = phase + 1.5 end local headPos = rootCF.Position + V3(0, 2, 0) local headTarget if S.headLook then headTarget = CFrame.lookAt(headPos, headPos + ray.Direction) else headTarget = CFrame.new(headPos) * cam.CFrame.Rotation end if S.headLook and headSmooth then headSmooth = headSmooth:Lerp(headTarget, 1 - exp(-dt * 18)) else headSmooth = headTarget end state.valid = true state.rootCF = rootCF state.headCF = headSmooth state.dirL = rootCF:VectorToWorldSpace(hands.L.dir) state.dirR = rootCF:VectorToWorldSpace(hands.R.dir) applyJoints() if remote and now - lastSend >= CFG.sendRate then lastSend = now remote:FireServer(headSmooth, rootCF * hands.L.cf, rootCF * hands.R.cf) end if S.hud then local pl, onL = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootCF:PointToWorldSpace(hands.L.pos)) local pr, onR = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootCF:PointToWorldSpace(hands.R.pos)) markerL.Visible = onL markerR.Visible = onR markerL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pl.X, pl.Y) markerR.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pr.X, pr.Y) markerL.BackgroundTransparency = activeL and 0.2 or 0.7 markerR.BackgroundTransparency = activeR and 0.2 or 0.7 else markerL.Visible = false markerR.Visible = false end end) local ncAcc = 0 bind(RunService.Stepped, function(_, dt) applyJoints() if S.noclip then ncAcc = ncAcc + dt if ncAcc >= 0.1 then ncAcc = 0 for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if other ~= plr and other.Character then for _, p in ipairs(other.Character:GetChildren()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end end end end end end end) shared.NexusVRPC_Cleanup = function() for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end CAS:UnbindAction("NexusVRPC_Wheel") S.enabled = false resetJoints() if gui then gui:Destroy() end shared.NexusVRPC_Cleanup = nil end refreshStatus() notify("Nexus VR PC listo · H para ayuda")

How to use:
Execute the script.
Hold Q to move your left hand, or E for your right hand. The hand follows your mouse cursor.
Use the mouse wheel to move your hand closer or farther.
Press H to see all the controls.
Controls:
Q / E: left / right hand follows your cursor
G: hold both hands together (Shift + scroll changes the width)
F: mirror mode
Scroll: move hand closer / farther
Z / C: rotate wrist
1-3: load saved pose (Ctrl + 1-3 to save)
R: record movement, P: play it back
L: head follows your cursor
X: long reach
T: keep hands in place / auto return
[ and ]: change smoothness
N: no-clip other players
V: turn VR on / off
Y: reset
H: help, U: hide the GUI
Notes:
The game must have Nexus VR Character Model, or it won't work.
Other players only see what the server replicates, so long reach may look shorter for them.
If something breaks, rejoin and execute again.

-- Blox League ball tracer: thin line showing where the ball will go, including bounces.
-- Press + (numpad + or = key) to toggle.
if getgenv().BallTracerCleanup then pcall(getgenv().BallTracerCleanup) end -- remove a previous run
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local CFG = {
	Enabled = true,
	Color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 205, 255),
	Thickness = 2,
	SimStep = 1 / 40,      -- seconds per drawn segment
	MaxTime = 3,           -- how far ahead to predict
	MaxBounces = 3,
	Gravity = 34,          -- measured from the real ball's flights (world gravity is 196, ball is floaty)
	FloorBounce = 0.65,
	WallBounce = 0.6,
	CornerRadius = 10,     -- radius of the curved floor/wall/ceiling corners
	GoalHalfWidth = 40,    -- rough goal opening, estimated from the goal model
	GoalHeight = 30,
	GoalDepth = 300,
	MinSpeed = 6,          -- hide the line when the ball is basically still
	Window = 0.15,         -- seconds of ball history used to estimate velocity (bigger = steadier, slower to react)
	GroundY = 5.6,         -- ball centre below this = rolling on the floor (no gravity in the speed fit)
	HitThreshold = 8,      -- studs of surprise movement that count as a hit/bounce and reset the estimate
}

local MAX_PTS = math.ceil(CFG.MaxTime / CFG.SimStep) + 2

-- Drawn with GUI frames (the Drawing library does not render on every setup)
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "BallTracer"
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 999
gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

local lines = {}
for i = 1, MAX_PTS do
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.Visible = false
	f.Parent = gui
	lines[i] = f
end
local conns = {}
getgenv().BallTracerCleanup = function()
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end
	gui:Destroy()
	getgenv().BallTracerCleanup = nil
end

local function hideFrom(n)
	for i = n, MAX_PTS do lines[i].Visible = false end
end

local function setLine(f, a, b)
	local d = b - a
	local len = d.Magnitude
	f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((a.X + b.X) / 2, (a.Y + b.Y) / 2)
	f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len + 1, CFG.Thickness) -- +1 hides hairline gaps between segments
	f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, d.X))
	f.BackgroundColor3 = CFG.Color
	f.Visible = true
end

local BOX = { min = Vector3.new(-205.8, 0, -257), max = Vector3.new(205.8, 103.7, 257) }

-- Ball velocity: the ball is anchored (physics velocity reads 0), so estimate it from position history.
-- Least-squares line through the last CFG.Window seconds after removing gravity's curve, which averages
-- out frame-time noise. A sudden unexpected jump (hit / bounce / reset) clears the history so it reacts fast.
local hist = {}
local vel = Vector3.zero
local base = nil -- smoothed ball position at "now"

local function updateState(ball, now)
	local p = ball.Position
	local grounded = p.Y < CFG.GroundY
	local G = Vector3.new(0, grounded and 0 or -CFG.Gravity, 0)
	local fresh = false
	local last = hist[#hist]
	if last then
		local dt = now - last.t
		if dt <= 0 then return end
		local pred = last.p + vel * dt + G * (0.5 * dt * dt)
		if (p - pred).Magnitude > CFG.HitThreshold or (p - last.p).Magnitude > 60 then
			hist = {}
			fresh = true
		end
	end
	hist[#hist + 1] = { t = now, p = p }
	while #hist > 2 and now - hist[1].t > CFG.Window do table.remove(hist, 1) end

	base = p
	local n = #hist
	if n < 2 or now - hist[1].t < 0.015 then return end

	local sumT, sumP = 0, Vector3.zero
	local pcs = table.create(n)
	local taus = table.create(n)
	for i, h in ipairs(hist) do
		local tau = h.t - now
		local pc = h.p - G * (0.5 * tau * tau) -- remove gravity so the rest is a straight line
		taus[i], pcs[i] = tau, pc
		sumT += tau
		sumP += pc
	end
	local tm, pm = sumT / n, sumP / n
	local sxx, sxy = 0, Vector3.zero
	for i = 1, n do
		local dtau = taus[i] - tm
		sxx += dtau * dtau
		sxy += (pcs[i] - pm) * dtau
	end
	if sxx < 1e-9 then return end
	local newVel = sxy / sxx
	vel = (fresh or n <= 3) and newVel or vel:Lerp(newVel, 0.5)
	base = pm - newVel * tm -- fitted position at "now" (steadier than the raw one)
end

local function project(p)
	local v = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(p)
	return Vector2.new(v.X, v.Y), v.Z
end

local pts = table.create(MAX_PTS)
local function step(now)
	local bodies = workspace:FindFirstChild("Bodies")
	local ball = bodies and bodies:FindFirstChild("Ball")
	if not CFG.Enabled or not ball then
		hideFrom(1)
		hist = {}
		return
	end
	cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	updateState(ball, now)

	local radius = math.max(ball.Size.X, ball.Size.Y, ball.Size.Z) / 2
	local p, v = base or ball.Position, vel
	if v.Magnitude < CFG.MinSpeed then hideFrom(1) return end
	local g = Vector3.new(0, -CFG.Gravity, 0)
	local R = CFG.CornerRadius
	local bounces, count, t = 0, 1, 0
	pts[1] = p

	while t < CFG.MaxTime and count < MAX_PTS do
		local nv = v + g * CFG.SimStep
		local np = p + (v + nv) * 0.5 * CFG.SimStep

		-- The arena has no collidable/queryable parts, so collide with a rounded box:
		-- every edge and corner is a quarter-pipe, so the ball rides up and along walls.
		local bmin, bmax = BOX.min, BOX.max
		if math.abs(np.X) < CFG.GoalHalfWidth and np.Y < CFG.GoalHeight then
			bmin = Vector3.new(bmin.X, bmin.Y, -CFG.GoalDepth)
			bmax = Vector3.new(bmax.X, bmax.Y, CFG.GoalDepth)
		end
		local lo = bmin + Vector3.one * (radius + R)
		local hi = bmax - Vector3.one * (radius + R)
		local q = Vector3.new(math.clamp(np.X, lo.X, hi.X), math.clamp(np.Y, lo.Y, hi.Y), math.clamp(np.Z, lo.Z, hi.Z))
		local d = np - q
		local dist = d.Magnitude
		if dist > R and dist > 1e-6 then
			local n = d / dist
			local vn = nv:Dot(n)
			if vn > 0 then
				np = q + n * R
				local e = CFG.WallBounce + (CFG.FloorBounce - CFG.WallBounce) * math.abs(n.Y)
				nv = nv - n * vn * (1 + e)
				if vn > 15 then bounces += 1 end -- a real impact, not just rolling along the curve
			end
		end

		count += 1
		pts[count] = np
		p, v = np, nv
		t += CFG.SimStep
		if bounces > CFG.MaxBounces then break end
		if v.Magnitude < CFG.MinSpeed and bounces > 0 then break end
	end

	-- project each point once, then draw segments between them (clipping at the camera plane)
	local scr, depth = table.create(count), table.create(count)
	for i = 1, count do scr[i], depth[i] = project(pts[i]) end
	local used = 0
	for i = 1, count - 1 do
		local a2, b2, ad, bd = scr[i], scr[i + 1], depth[i], depth[i + 1]
		if ad > 0 or bd > 0 then
			if ad <= 0 then
				a2 = project(pts[i]:Lerp(pts[i + 1], (0.1 - ad) / (bd - ad)))
			elseif bd <= 0 then
				b2 = project(pts[i]:Lerp(pts[i + 1], (0.1 - ad) / (bd - ad)))
			end
			used += 1
			setLine(lines[used], a2, b2)
		end
	end
	hideFrom(used + 1)
end

    local tl = guiObject.AbsolutePosition

    pcall(_G.AntiBang_Shutdown)

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterGui       = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- {{ toggle }}

local CONFIG = {
    ENABLED = true, -- turn anti off or on (use true or false)
}

local NOTIFY = true -- notify if it succeeded (use true or false)

local function getTorso(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getRoot(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return (hum and hum.RootPart) or char.PrimaryPart
end

local function notify(title, text)
    if not NOTIFY then return end
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = title, Text = text, Duration = 3
        })
    end)
end

local function matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso)
    local theirChar = plr.Character
    if not theirChar then return false end

    local theirHRP = theirChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not theirHRP then return false end

    local localOffset = myTorso.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(theirHRP.Position)

    if math.abs(localOffset.X) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Y) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Z - 1.1) > 0.25 then return false end

    local dot = theirHRP.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(myTorso.CFrame.LookVector)
    if dot < 0.995 then return false end

    return true
end

local dipBusy = false
local function voidDip()
    if dipBusy then return end
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local root = getRoot(myChar)
    if not root or not root.Parent then return end

    dipBusy = true
    local savedCF = root.CFrame
    local savedDH = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -1e9

    local t0 = tick()
    pcall(function()
        while tick() - t0 < 0.15 do
            if not root.Parent then break end
            root.CFrame                  = CFrame.new(0, -800, 0)
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            task.wait()
        end
    end)

    if root.Parent then
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.CFrame                  = savedCF
        local hum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end
    end

    task.wait()
    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = savedDH
    dipBusy = false
end

local confirmCount = {}
local lastAction   = 0

local steppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not CONFIG.ENABLED then return end
    if dipBusy then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local myTorso = getTorso(myChar)
    if not myTorso then return end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            if matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso) then
                confirmCount[plr] = (confirmCount[plr] or 0) + 1

                if confirmCount[plr] >= 5 then
                    confirmCount[plr] = 0

                    if tick() - lastAction < 1.5 then
                        return
                    end
                    lastAction = tick()

                    notify("Anti-Bang", "Bang confirmed from " .. plr.Name)
                    voidDip()
                    return
                end
            else
                confirmCount[plr] = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)

local inputConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
        CONFIG.ENABLED = not CONFIG.ENABLED
        notify("Anti-Bang", CONFIG.ENABLED and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
    end
end)

local removeConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    confirmCount[plr] = nil
end)

local charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    confirmCount = {}
    dipBusy      = false
end)

_G.AntiBang_Shutdown = function()
    steppedConn:Disconnect()
    inputConn:Disconnect()
    removeConn:Disconnect()
    charConn:Disconnect()
end

_G.AntiBang_Toggle = function(state)
    if type(state) == "boolean" then
        CONFIG.ENABLED = state
    else
        CONFIG.ENABLED = not CONFIG.ENABLED
    end
    notify("Anti-Bang", CONFIG.ENABLED and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
end

	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

	for _, d in espData do

		if line then

			local show = false
			if rt and rt.Parent then
				local p = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rt.Position)
				if p.Z > 0 then
					show = true
					if d.px ~= p.X or d.py ~= p.Y then
						d.px, d.py = p.X, p.Y
						local dx, dy = p.X - ax, p.Y - ay
						line.Position = offset(ax + dx / 2, ay + dy / 2)
						line.Size = offset(2, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy))
						line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)) - 90
					end
				else
					d.px = nil
				end
			end
			if line.Visible ~= show then
				line.Visible = show
			end
		end
	end

local function spawnSkyboxWithID(textureID, label)

	local tool

	for _, v in ipairs(player:GetDescendants()) do
		if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then tool = v.Parent break end
	end
	if not tool then
		for _, v in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
			if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then tool = v.Parent break end
		end
	end

	if not tool then
		warn(("[" .. label .. "] F3X not found"))
		return
	end

	local remote = tool.SyncAPI.ServerEndpoint
	local function _(args) pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(unpack(args)) end) end

	local function CreatePart(cf, parent) _({"CreatePart", "Normal", cf, parent}) end
	local function AddMesh(part) _({"CreateMeshes", {{Part = part}}}) end
	local function SetMesh(part, meshid) _({"SyncMesh", {{Part = part, MeshId = "rbxassetid://" .. meshid}}}) end
	local function SetTexture(part, texid) _({"SyncMesh", {{Part = part, TextureId = "rbxassetid://" .. texid}}}) end
	local function MeshResize(part, size) _({"SyncMesh", {{Part = part, Scale = size}}}) end
	local function SetName(part, stringg) _({"SetName", {part}, stringg}) end
	local function SetCollision(part, boolean) _({"SyncCollision", {{Part = part, CanCollide = boolean}}}) end
	local function SetLocked(part, boolean) _({"SetLocked", {part}, boolean}) end
	local function SetAnchor(part, boolean) _({"SyncAnchor", {{Part = part}, Anchored = boolean}}) end

	local spawnCF = CFrame.new(0, 500, 0)

	CreatePart(spawnCF, workspace)
	task.wait(0.2)

	local skyPart
	local closest = math.huge
	for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			local d = (v.Position - spawnCF.Position).Magnitude
			if d < 10 and d < closest then
				closest = d
				skyPart = v
			end
		end
	end

	if not skyPart then
		warn(("[" .. label .. "] part not found"))
		return
	end

	SetName(skyPart, "Sky")
	task.wait(0.05)

	AddMesh(skyPart)
	task.wait(0.1)
	SetMesh(skyPart, "111891702759441")
	task.wait(0.1)
	SetTexture(skyPart, textureID)
	task.wait(0.1)

	MeshResize(skyPart, Vector3.new(1000, 1000, 1000))
	task.wait(0.2)

	SetCollision(skyPart, false)
	SetLocked(skyPart, true)
	SetAnchor(skyPart, true)

	local guardConn
	guardConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not skyPart or not skyPart.Parent then
			if guardConn then guardConn:Disconnect() end
			return
		end
		if skyPart.Position.Y < 100 then
			pcall(function() skyPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 500, 0) end)
			SetAnchor(skyPart, true)
		end
	end)
end

local function unanchorAll()
	local remote = getF3XRemote()
	if not remote then
		warn("[Unanchor All] F3X not found — click [F3X] first")
		return
	end

	local function fire(args)
		pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(unpack(args)) end)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local parts = {}
		for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				parts[#parts + 1] = v
			end
		end

		local total = #parts
		print("[Unanchor All] Найдено частей:", total)
		local t0 = tick()

		if total == 0 then
			print("[Unanchor All] Нечего откреплять.")
			return
		end

		local completed = 0

		for i = 1, total do
			local part = parts[i]
			task.spawn(function()
				if part and part.Parent then
					fire({"SyncAnchor", {{Part = part}, false}})
					fire({"SetLocked", {part}, false})
				end
				completed = completed + 1
			end)
		end

		while completed < total do
			task.wait()
		end

		local elapsed = tick() - t0
		print(string.format("[Unanchor All] Карта откреплена за %.2f сек! (%d частей)", elapsed, total))

	bodyGyro.CFrame = root.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root
